optimize.dispatch_note: one vertex of a degenerate optimal face, not a unique answer: PyPSA's own Kirchhoff cycle basis differs between runs (2372 or 2469 nonzeros over the same 364 cycles), and generators move by up to 750 MW between the two resulting optima while the objective agrees to 2e-8 relative. Gate on `objective` and `bus_marginal_price`; `generator_p`, `line_p0` and `transformer_p0` under `optimize` are one feasible optimum among many

pf.note: PyPSA's own Newton-Raphson did not converge on this network from a flat start, so there are no reference values to record
